newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were unchanged in quiet late trading on Friday on poor buying interest, traders said.

They said palm olein was unchanged at 1,405 rupiah/kg in Jakarta with credit offers being heard at 1,410-15 rupiah/kg. Traders offered crude palm oil at 1,230-35 rupiah/kg in the north Sumatran city of Medan.

Traders said they did not hear any fresh tender and that players were taking to the sidelines after falls in Malaysia. "Buyers are still waiting to see if the fall of prices in Malaysia will affect the local market," said one trader.
But some traders said they expected a bullish trend next week ahead of the Eid al-Adha celebration on April 18 as they believed demand would pick up.
